pages.text: Success! We've successfully created a slab of scarred stone, also known as a Rune. These runes possess intriguing properties; it appears that they can be utilized to manipulate flux, inducing peculiar phenomena. However, before I can harness their potential,
I must devise a method to arrange these runes into what is referred to as a "spell." I believe a design akin to this schematic could suffice

Furthermore, I require a means to activate these runes by infusing them with significant amounts of flux. I speculate that affixing a sizable chunk of flux to the end of a stick might serve this purpose. While it may not be aesthetically pleasing, it may prove effective in triggering the runes.
